# Recorded Conseq responses

Fund pages and their price history `.xlsx` downloads, recorded from conseq.cz on 2026-10-10 and trimmed to keep the repo small:

- price rows (in the `.xlsx` and the page's chart data) outside 2021-04-01 to 2021-07-01 removed
- `<script>` and `<svg>` contents and the `__VIEWSTATE` value emptied

`pricehist-<productid>.xlsx` is the download linked from the page as `Pricehist.ashx?productid=<productid>`.
